reason: Three problems. (1) The attribution is not supported. The 0.956 block grows by about 12 teams in every daily burst, including before 743929 existed. A TeamId diff of e10_watch 20260926T2246Z vs 20260927T1101Z shows 12 teams entering 0.956 (4 new, 4 from 0.954, 2 from 0.953, 2 from 0.955) before the post (27 Sep 19:30Z; the knobs were disclosed at 22:57Z). The block went 44 (27 Sep 11:01Z) -> 56 (28 Sep 06:39Z) -> 68 (10:17Z). The 06:39Z -> 10:17Z window had 18 entrants (10 from 0.955, 4 from 0.953, 3 from 0.954, 1 new) and 6 leavers upward, all submitted 00:17-03:29Z. That is the normal reset burst, so the timing says nothing about the source. (2) The mechanism does not fit John Taylor's own numbers. He measured +0.001 per knob on his 0.957 base (x138 + an undisclosed ported post-processing stage), not on bare x138. Both knobs on x138 would predict at most ~0.955, so they do not explain the 0.953 -> 0.956 jumps (+0.003). Ten of the 18 entrants were already at 0.955, off x138 on their own lines, where one-step +0.001 moves are routine. (3) The finding changes nothing. It proposes no build, no slot and no rule. Probe 50 (exp85a, ref 56629533) is already pre-registered under W2b amendment A (09:35Z: R+ = display >= 0.957, else exp83c/exp81). The size of the public tie block is display-only (public ~29%, one embryo) and carries no private information. It also has a small downside: it primes the probe-50 read with 'the crowd got 0.956 from these knobs', a post-hoc story the pre-registration forbids. The 'same as our exp70g' framing is also stale, because our best is now 0.957 (exp79a, CI, probe 48).
fix: Do not log this as a hypothesis or cite it when reading probe 50. Read 56629533 only with the amendment-A codes (>= 0.957 -> exp87a if its dummy passes, else exp86c; 0.956/<=0.955/? -> exp83c, else exp81). If a crowd note is wanted, log only the measured fact: 18 entrants and +12 net in the 0.956 block over 06:39Z-10:17Z, against a pre-743929 baseline of 12 entrants per burst, so it is not anomalous. No build, no slot.
